reconstructed_theorem_text: Definition. Let I be a finite type with decidable equality, let (Omega,m,mu) be a finite measure space with an NNReal-indexed filtration F, and fix T>=0. Let S={w in R^I: ||w||=1}. Given a jointly measurable X:[0,infinity) x Omega -> S which is strongly progressive for F, and a measurable a:[0,infinity)->R with there existing C in R such that |a(t)|<=C for every t<=T, the definition takes i,j in I and returns a real progressive L2 integrand on horizon T. Its process field, at every t>=0 and every omega, is sqrt(2*a(t))*(delta_ij-X_i(t,omega)*X_j(t,omega)). Equivalently it is sqrt(2*a(t)) times coordinate i of e_j-X_j(t,omega)*X(t,omega). The structure includes proofs that this process is strongly progressive and that (omega,t) mapped to its value belongs to L2(mu product lambda_T), where lambda_T is real Lebesgue measure restricted to [0,T], transported to NNReal. The displayed auxiliary proof bindings do not alter this process field. No nonnegativity of a or positivity of T is required; sqrt is the total real square root (zero for negative input).
objects: I, Omega, m, mu, filtration F, horizon T, unit sphere S, X, temperature a, indices i,j, returned integrand.
domains: I finite with decidable equality; Omega arbitrary measurable type; mu finite; time NNReal; X takes values in the induced Borel unit-sphere subtype of EuclideanSpace R I; output real-valued.
quantifiers: For every I, Omega, F, mu, T, X and supplied measurability/progressiveness proofs, every measurable a and proof of exists C for all t<=T, and every i then j, construct one integrand.
assumptions: Finite measure; joint measurability and strong progressiveness of X; measurability of a; exists real C uniform over [0,T] bounding |a|.
conclusion: Pointwise process formula sqrt(2*a(t))*(delta_ij-X_i*X_j), with strong-progressiveness and L2 product-measure certification.
scopes: Process formula holds for all t>=0, even beyond T; only L2 certification and boundedness hypothesis are restricted to T. No Brownian process is an input.
constant_dependencies: The supplied bound may depend on T and a. The process formula depends only on X,a,i,j; its horizon-dependent structure/certificates also use F,mu,T and the hypothesis proofs.
context_ambiguities: None identified from the supplied statement and definition context.
